cmd.mep.disconnect.desc: Disconnects a device or a run end from the network. Pick the connector or the run end.
cmd.mep.browser.desc: Shows systems, flow and sizes per run, devices and plain check findings.
hint.conduit.first: Conduit: first point of the route · Esc to cancel
hint.conduit.next: Conduit: next point · Enter or click a network to finish · Esc to cancel
hint.terminal.place: Air terminal: pick the location · Space to rotate · Esc to exit
hint.fixture.place: Plumbing fixture: pick the location · Space to rotate · Esc to exit
hint.light.place: Light: pick the location · Esc to exit
hint.device.place: Device or equipment: pick the location, wall devices sit on the nearest wall · Esc to exit
hint.connect.place: Connect: pick a device connector or an open run end · Esc to exit
hint.disconnect.place: Disconnect: pick a device connector or a run end · Esc to exit
hint.route.first: Auto route: start at a connector, run or point · Esc to cancel
hint.route.end: Auto route: end at a connector, run or point · Esc to cancel
mep.err.no_target: No connector or run end here
mep.err.no_system: Choose a system, or start from a run
mep.err.no_section: Choose a system with a section, or start from a connector or a run
mep.err.no_network: No suitable network nearby. Draw a route first.
mep.err.no_other_run: This system has no other run.
mep.err.no_room: A route cannot be laid here: no room for a fitting, or the connector faces the other way.
mep.err.no_size: The material catalog has no such size.
mep.err.wrong_system: This connector does not fit the system.
mep.err.two_systems: The route ends belong to different systems.
mep.err.already_connected: This connector is already connected. Disconnect it first.
mep.err.port_on_run: The connector lies on the middle of a run, there is no node here. Move the device or split the run.
mep.browser.title: System browser
mep.browser.empty: No systems yet. Draw a route or add a system.
mep.browser.indicative: This check is indicative: no codes are applied. Limits are typical values and flows are added up without diversity. Size from a proper calculation.
mep.browser.summary: Total {flow} {unit} · length {length} m · fittings {fittings} · connected parts {parts}
mep.issue.network: The network cannot be built: no room for a fitting or too many branches ({message}).
mep.issue.broken: The system is broken into {parts} unconnected parts. Join them.
mep.issue.not_connected: Device {comp} ({connector}) belongs to the system but no route reaches it.
mep.issue.wrong_system: Connector {connector} of device {comp} does not fit this system.
mep.issue.no_flow: The system has no flow: no consumer is connected.
mep.issue.zero_flow: The connected devices have no flow set, so speed and size cannot be estimated. Set it in the device table.
mep.issue.loop: The network has a loop: the closing run gets no flow.
mep.issue.undersized: Run {run}: {speed} m/s is above the {limit} m/s guide value. {suggest} would do.
mep.issue.undersized_no_size: Run {run}: {speed} m/s is above the {limit} m/s guide value. The catalog has no suitable size.
mep.issue.overflow: Run {run}: the summed flow of {flow} l/s is above the {capacity} l/s guide value (half-full pipe, no diversity). {suggest} or more slope would do.
mep.issue.overflow_no_size: Run {run}: the summed flow of {flow} l/s is above the {capacity} l/s guide value (half-full pipe, no diversity). The catalog has no suitable size, more slope may help.
mep.issue.overload: Run {run}: about {amps} A is above the {limit} A guide value.
mep.issue.port_size: Run {run} ({size} mm) is smaller than connector {connector} of device {comp} ({port} mm).
mep.issue.port_approach: Run {run} meets connector {connector} of device {comp} off its axis or at an angle. Check the route.
mep.issue.slope_low: Run {run} slopes {pct} %, the guide value is at least {min} %.
mep.issue.slope_reverse: Run {run} slopes the wrong way, taking the lowest open end of the largest section as the outlet.
